༄༅/ /ya mān+ta ka las/gnas skabs 'byung po'i dbang po brgyad nye bar sgrub pa'i tho bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// ya mān+ta ka las/ gnas skabs 'byung po'i dbang po brgyad nye bar sgrub pa'i tho bzhugs so//

bdud dang gshin rje la sogs pa// ma rungs pa rnams skad cig la// 'joms mdzad 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhes// khro chen srid gsum za des srungs// zla gsang gi bsnyen pa zhi drag tshad du thems shing bcu cha'i sbyin sreg kyang rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// gnas skabs kyi yon tan sgrub pa'i 'byung po brgyad kyi bsgrub pa ni/ dang po gzhan gyis mi thub pa bsgrub pa'i thabs ni/ zla ba gang yang rung ba'i dkar po'i tshes gcig nas bcu bzhi'i bar du/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi bris sku'i mdun du rang der gsal bas/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bhū ta a pa ra dzi ta bkug nas mdun du bka' nyan par bsam/ de la zho dang bu ram 'o ma 'bras dkar gyis mchod nas/ rat+na'i phreng ba bzung ste/ oṃ hrīḥdzaḥ.a pa ra dzi ta hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes 'bum sogs bzlas/ nya'i nub mo mchod pa snga ma bas bzang du bshams pa phul nas/ gu gul nag po'i bdug pa rgyun ma chad par byas te/ mtshan de gnyid spangs nas bzlas pas tho rangs mi dkar po mig che ba/ gzugs ma nges pa 'ongs pa de la mi 'jigs par bzlas pas/ des bdag gis ci bya bka' stsol ces zer du 'ong*/ de la 'di sgrubs shig ces bsgo/ des ni ci bcol byed/ rgyab tu khur nas lha'i gnas su'ang 'gro/ dgra rnams tshar gcod cing*/ rgyal srid dang longs spyod sogs gang 'dod pa ster/ bskal pa bdun du yang 'tsho bar byed do// gnyis pa mi thub pa bsgrub pa ni/ tshes gcig nas bdun gyi bar/ bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten gyi rtsar/ rang gshin rje'i gshed gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis a dzi ta bkug nas/ mdun du bka' nyan par bsam/ dkar gsum gyis mchod cing*/ dung gi phreng bar/ oṃ hūm̐ dzaḥ.a dzi ta hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes ma yeng bar stong phrag brgyad bzlas/ tshes brgyad kyi nub mchod pa snga ma bas bzang ba 'bul/ gu gul nag po ma chad par bdug cing mtshan der gnyid spangs nas bzlas pas/

tho rangs la kho nges par 'ongs te ci byed zer drir 'ong*/ de la bdag gis ci bya khyod mkhyen no// zhes smras pas/ ci bcol ba byed/ rgyal srid sogs ster/ lo stong 'tsho bar byed do// gsum pa gang ba bsgrub pa ni/ gsang sngags kyi lha'i khang par/ rang gshin rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis gang ba bkug nas/ mdun du bka' nyan par bsam/ dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis mchod nas/ rat+na'i phreng ba bzung la/ oṃ hūm̐ dzaḥpū ra ṇa hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes tshes gcig nas bdun bar stong phrag brgyad bzlas/ tshes brgyad nub mchod pa bzang du bshams la 'bul/ gu gul ma chad par bdug |gnyid spangs nas bzlas pas kho mtshan phyed nas 'ong*/ de la me tog sna tshogs kyis mchod nas bka' bsgos pas kho mnyes nas rgyal srid ster/ bsam pa thams cad rdzogs par byed/ che ge mo 'chi ba'am 'tsho bar gyis shig ces gang bsgo ba thams cad byed/ rang ji srid 'tsho'i bar ci bcol ba sgrub/ lo stong yang 'tsho bar byed do// bzhi pa kun tu gang ba bsgrub pa ni/ gdung bzhugs pa'i mchod rten gyi rtsar/ rang gshin rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis kun tu rgyu gang ba bkug nas bka' nyan par bsam/ dkar mngar gyis mchod/ tshes gcig nas bcu'i bar rat+na'i phreng ba bzung nas/ oṃ hūm̐ dzaḥ.ā pū ra ṇa swā hā/ zhes bzlas/ tshes bcu gcig gi nub mchod pa bzang pos mchod/ gu gul ma chad par bdug /gnyid spangs nas bzlas pas kho mtshan phyed nas 'ongs shing ci bya zhes 'drir 'ong*/ de la bdag gis ci bya khyod shes so// zhes smras pas/ ji srid bar ci bcol nyan/ gnod sbyin gyi bu mo'ang bkug nas ster/ nyin re bzhin zas gos sbyin/ lo lnga brgya sogs 'tsho bar byed do// lnga pa dur khrod bdag po bsgrub pa ni/ mtshan mo dur khrod du/ rang gshin rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis dur khrod bdag po bkug /mdun du bka' nyan par bsam/

nya sha/ til/ sran dkar/ zho/ bu ram/ ka ra sogs zas bzang pos mchod/ tshes gcig nas bdun gyi bar du rat+na'i phreng ba bzung nas/ oṃ bh+rūṃ dzaḥsh+ma shā na a dhi pa ti hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes stong phrag brgyad bzlas/ tshes brgyad pa'i nub gu gul ma chad par bdug /mchod pa bzang pos mchod cing gnyid spangs nas bzlas pas/ mtshan phyed ha hā zhes pa'i sgra drag po 'byung ngo*// kho 'khor 'jigs pas bskor nas 'ong*/ mi 'jigs par gtor ma phul nas mnyes par byas na 'byung po thams cad bran bzhin 'gyur/ 'dod don thams cad sgrub/ dgra thams cad 'joms/ lo stong yang 'tsho bar 'gyur ro// drug pa rigs kyi dbang phyug bsgrub pa ni/ lha'i khang par/ rang gshin rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis rigs kyi dbang phyug bkug /mdun du bka' nyan par bsam/ dri dang ldan pa'i me tog dmar po dang*/ nya sha dang*/ til dang*/ zan dmar pos mchod/ rat+na'i phreng ba bzung la/ oṃ truṃ dzaḥku le shwa ra hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes tshes gcig nas bcu bzhi'i bar du zhag re la khri khrag re bzla| bco lnga'i nub mo mchod pa bzang du 'bul/ gu gul dang du ru ka ma chad par bdug /gnyid spangs nas bzlas pas/ mtshan phyed kho 'bar zhing 'jigs pa'i gzugs kyis 'ong*/ de la ma 'jigs par mchod gtor 'bul/ mnyes par byas pas ci byed ces smrar 'ong*/ de la bdag ci bya ba khyod kyis shes so// zhes smras pas/ ji srid bar nyin re bzhin 'dod pa'i don sbyin/ lha'i longs spyod 'byung*/ lo lnga brgya yang 'tsho bar byed do// bdun pa dbang phyug bsgrub pa ni/ dbang rten mtshan ma 'dra ba'i rtsar/ bdag gshin rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis dbang phyug bkug /mdun du bka' nyan par bsam/ bza' ba dmar po/ nya sha/ til la sogs pas mchod/ rat+na'i phreng ba bzung la/ oṃ hūm̐ dzaḥbhū te shwa ra hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes zhag gnyis la khri phrag re bzla/ gsum pa'i nub mchod gtor bzang du 'bul/

gu gul ma chad par bdug cing bzlas pas kho mdun du 'ongs nas ci bya zer/ de la bdag gi 'dod pa sgrubs shig /ces brjod/ des ni rtag tu rang gi phyir 'brangs shing*/ nges par slong na lha mo yang ster/ zas gos mi zad pa'i gter 'byung*/ lo stong phrag gnyis kyang 'tsho bar byed do| |brgyad pa pho nya mchog bsgrub pa ni/ gsang sngags kyi lha'i khang par/ rang gshin rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis pho nya mchog bkug /mdun du bka' nyan par bsam/ tsan+dan dkar po'i maṇ+ḍal bshams/ zho mar sbyar ba'i bza' ba dkar po dang*/ ku sha'i chun po nye bar 'dug pa'i mar me sbar/ gu gul bdug /mchod gtor 'bul/ rat+na'i phreng ba bzung la/ oṃ aṃ dzaḥkiṃ ka ra ut+ta ma hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes dmar cha'i tshes bdun nas zhag bdun bzla'o// brgyad pa'i nub mchod pa bzang du 'bul/ gu gul ma chad par bdug /gnyid spangs nas bzlas pas mtshan phyed tsam nas kho 'ong*/ de la tsan+dan dkar pos chus mchod pas mnyes nas bdag gis ci bya zer du 'ong*/ de la bdag ci bya ba khyod kyis shes so// zhes smras pas/ de nas bzung ci bcol byed/ don 'bras thams cad ster/ lo dpag med 'tsho bar byed do// zhes pa rnams ni nges pa'o// de ltar 'byung po brgyad gang bsgrubs kyang gshin rje'i gshed la bsnyen pa thems pa/ dus tshod dang tshes grangs ma nor ba/ gtsang sbra che ba/ grib la 'dzems shing*/ nyin mtshan dus drug tu mchod gtor la brtson pa/ the tshom med pa/ gzhan dang ma phrad pa/ mtshams dam pa/ smra ba bcad pa/ sems ma g.yengs pa/ grub rtags gzhan la gsang ba rnams shin tu gal che/ de ltar bsgrub na nges par 'grub/ gal te sngags kyi sgra ma dag pa dang*/ sems g.yengs pa sogs dam tshig snga ma rnams las 'das pa dang*/ dus snyigs ma'i dbang gis sgrib pa shas che ba dang*/ nyon mongs pa mang ba dang*/ dkor zas sogs zos pa dang*/ nyams grib phog pa sogs kyi rkyen la brten/

lan gcig bsgrubs pas ma 'grub na lan gsum/ des kyang ma 'grub na lan lnga'am| bdun nam/ bcu'i bar sngar kho nas bskyar zhing bsgrub na mi 'grub mi srid do// zhes pa'ang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba'i gsungs las/ slar tshig cung zad bsdus te/ rung mthun du gshin rje tshe bdag gi las phran du/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas/ me byi'i mgo zla ba'i dmar po'i rgyal ba dang po la dpal 'bri gung gi gdan sa chen por bris pa yin no// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
